subject: Overlay two plots (same x range, but different y ranges)

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: Overlay two plots (same x range, but different y ranges)
parts:
Hi,

Suppose that I want plot x vs y1 and x vs y2 in the same plot. The
axis at the bottom is from 1 to 10 (shared by x vs y1 plot and x vs y2
plot), the axis on the left is from 1 to 10 (for x vs y1 plot only),
and the axis on the right is from -100 to -10 (for x vs y2 plot only).

x=1:10
y1=1:10
y2=-10*(1:10)

I quickly looked through figures in the ggplot2 book and I don't see
an example that combines two figure into one (please excuse me if I
miss anything). But I think that ggplot2 is versatile to be used to
plot such a figure. Could any experience user let me know how to do
so? Thanks!

--
Regards,
Peng
